# technitium_settings_sso (Data Source)

Reads what `technitium_settings_sso` manages, without managing it.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `allow_signup` (Boolean) Create an account for a new user the first time they sign in with single sign-on.
- `allow_signup_only_for_mapped_users` (Boolean) Let a new user sign up only when they are in at least one provider group in `group_map`.
- `authority` (String) The OpenID Connect authority URL of the provider.
- `client_id` (String) The OpenID Connect client ID.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Allow signing in with single sign-on.
- `group_map` (Attributes Set) Maps the provider's groups to local groups. An SSO user's local groups are synced from it each time they sign in. An empty set removes the map. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--group_map))
- `id` (String) The identifier, as the resource has it.
- `metadata_address` (String) The OpenID Connect discovery URL, when the provider does not use the default one.
- `scopes` (List of String) The OpenID Connect scopes to request. Technitium's default is `openid`, `profile` and `email`.

<a id="nestedatt--group_map"></a>
### Nested Schema for `group_map`

Read-Only:

- `local_group` (String) The local group its members join.
- `remote_group` (String) The group at the SSO provider.
